source.title: Topsfield Fair Opens Entries for 2026 Competitions , Promotes $20K Pumpkin Prize

en.summary: The Topsfield Fair is now accepting entries for its 2026 competitions, with a $20,000 prize for the largest pumpkin.
en.why_irrelevant: It's a niche agricultural contest far from typical daily feeds.
